rows.en: (I promised to go out with Alto today.)

Hey, \p.
So, where are we going today?
Yeah... actually, I haven't thought about it at all...

Hey, wait! You invited me out
and you didn't plan anything?!

Hey, calm down.
It's nice to spend a day like this once in a while, right?
Geez, this doesn't bode well.
Hey, hurry up, or I'm leaving you behind.
Heh, come on, that's way too tacky, isn't it?
rows.notes: Outing montage: Alto reacts to something the player picks out (not shown).

rows.en: Geez, we're still going?
Ahahaha, what kind of stupid stunt is that?
Phew, I'm pretty worn out...
No wonder, after running around all day.
Ah, sorry, sorry.
There's a limit to everything, you know. Honestly.
Yeah, you're right.
But, well... it wasn't bad.

Having this much fun, I...
Nah, never mind.
What is it? Now you're creeping me out.

I'm just saying, maybe a day like this
is nice once in a while.
I see. Glad to hear it.
But I'll pass for a good while.
Hahaha.

(Guess things work out even without a plan.
Looks like Alto had fun too.)
(I promised to go out with Saotome-kun today.)
Yeah... actually, I haven't thought about it at all...

Come on, calm down!
It's nice to spend a day like this once in a while, right?
Come on, that's way too tacky, isn't it?
Phew, I'm a little tired...
Ah, I'm really sorry.
Yeah, you're right.
Hm?
rows.notes: Shared by both player genders in several scenes.

rows.en: What? Now you're creeping me out.
I see. I'm glad.
Ahaha.
rows.notes: Used 30 times: both player genders, Luca, Akimizu; 'Ahaha' as in the finished slices.

rows.en:
(Guess things work out even without a plan.
Looks like Saotome-kun had fun too.)
(I'm going shopping with Alto again today.)
Hey, Alto.

Hey, \p.
You did decide where we're going this time, right?
Well... sort of... more or less...

No plan again today...?
Geez, you're hopeless...

Phew, I could do with a little less winging it.
Well, it was fun enough, though.
Hahaha, all's well that ends well, then.
(I had a blast today too!)
(I'm going shopping with Saotome-kun again today.)
Ahaha, all's well that ends well, then.
(I had a blast today too!)
(I'm supposed to meet Alto at "Silver Moon.")
rows.notes: Silver Moon is provisional in locations.json.

rows.en:
\p.
You're here already?
Yeah, I just got here, though.
By the way, did you see Luca's EX-Gear today?
Huh? I wasn't paying any attention to it...

His engine unit wasn't the usual one.
His acceleration and stability on the climb
were in a whole other league.
You two are close, so why not just ask him?

No, I did ask. And he goes,
'Huh? What do you mean? It's the same as always?'
Honestly.
He doesn't have to hide it...
Now, now.

And then there's Michael. At the practical exam,
he goes, 'Ladies first. After you, Princess Alto,'
the jerk...
rows.notes: Mihaeru in the Japanese, so 'Michael'. Alto's 'iiyagaru' (rude verb ending) carried by 'the jerk'. 'Princess Alto' as in the finished rows.

rows.en: Isn't that just his usual routine...?
Geez, every last one of them!
By the way, Alto, what do you usually do at home?

Hm? Ah, let's see. Cleaning, laundry, cooking...
I do the housework, and before I know it,
the time's gone. That kind of thing.
Oh, you live on your own, right?
Yeah. It's been over a year now, I guess...
...Alto... you'd make a great wife...
Why, you little...!!
Ah, sorry, I was just joking...
(Alto's vibe has kind of changed since before.)
(I'm supposed to meet Saotome-kun at "Silver Moon.")
rows.notes: Silver Moon is provisional in locations.json.

rows.en: Yeah, I just got here.
That's just his usual routine, isn't it...

By the way, Saotome-kun, what do you usually
do at home?

Hm? Ah, let's see. Cleaning, laundry, cooking...
I do the housework, and before I know it,
the time's gone. That kind of thing.
Oh, you live on your own, right?
...Saotome-kun... you'd make a great wife...
Why... you... little...!!
Ah, sorryyy, I'm kidding, just kidding...
(Saotome-kun's vibe might have changed since before.)
(I'm supposed to meet Alto at "Silver Moon" again today.)
rows.notes: Silver Moon is provisional in locations.json.

rows.en:
Hey, \p.
You got here earlier than I expected.

...and that's how it went. Geez.
Can you believe it?
rows.notes: Time skip: Alto is ending a rant whose start is not shown.
